Sword and Shield... The Legends Awaken! (Part 1) (Japanese: ソード＆シールド「最強の剣と盾」① Sword & Shield - The Ultimate Sword and Shield 1) is the thirteenth chapter of the manga. It is based on the episodes Sword and Shield, Slumbering Weald! and Sword and Shield: The Darkest Day!.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
and Goh encounter and , respectively, for the first time.
Ash meets again and joins him in stopping rampaging Dynamax Pokémon.
Goh meets Sonia and helps her investigate the Darkest Day.
Ash meets Rose and Oleana for the first time.
Oleana's subordinate's Gigantamax destroys the mural at Stow-on-Side, revealing statues of Zacian and Zamazenta behind it.

==Differences between the animated series and the manga==
The manga opens with and Goh encountering and . 
Goh is never seen a .
The battle with Gigantamax is shortened. Ash doesn't use or to battle it.
Ash and do not battle Dynamax .
and Professor Magnolia's appearances are omitted.
Goh and Sonia never visit Turffield or Wedgehurst. Goh never obtains a Dynamax Band.
Ash doesn't use against Gigantamax .
Ash never has dinner with Rose and Oleana at Rose Tower. Rose's offer is instead made during their first encounter.
never uses Dynamax. The Stow-on-Side mural is destroyed by Oleana's subordinate's Gigantamax instead.
